correctness.rationale: Because the order is definable in the reduct, complete tuple types are weak orders. Equality plus the ternary relation records the minimum of each triple of distinct value-blocks. Counting how often a block is a triple-minimum uniquely ranks all blocks except the top two; those top two can be swapped without changing any atomic relation. This gives exactly two completions for every nonconstant quantifier-free type and yields the formulas. The arity lower bound follows from transitivity and non-homogeneity.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Those qualitative results contain the local top-two-swap mechanism but do not by themselves state the exact profile or the uniform two-to-one quotient. The present result is positioned as a quantitative sharpening, not as a new obstruction mechanism.
